faq_items.question: Is this affirmation wall art really free to download?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The Good Vibes Only affirmation set is a completely free printable PDF with no email sign-up required. Download it, print as many copies as you like at home, and frame them for any room. It is for personal home use, so print freely for yourself and gifts.

faq_items.question: What paper should I use to print wall art at home?
faq_items.answer: Use matte photo paper or 65-to-100 lb cardstock rather than plain copy paper. Heavier stock gives prints a substantial, gallery feel and will not curl inside a frame. Set your printer to High or Best quality and print at 100 percent, or Actual size, for the crispest, truest result.

faq_items.question: What size should I print affirmation wall art?
faq_items.answer: These designs fit standard photo sizes like 5x7, 8x10, and 11x14, so any off-the-shelf frame works with no custom matting. Print at 8x10 for a versatile desk or shelf piece, or scale up to 11x14 or A4 for a larger statement wall above a bed or sofa.

faq_items.question: Do affirmations on the wall actually work?
faq_items.answer: They help through repetition, not magic. When an encouraging phrase sits in your daily line of sight, you read it without trying, and that steady exposure gently shifts your self-talk. Choosing specific, present-tense, believable affirmations, like I can do hard things, makes them far more likely to sink in over time.

faq_items.question: How do I hang prints without damaging the walls?
faq_items.answer: Use adhesive mounting strips to hold lightweight frames securely without nail holes, which is ideal for renters and dorms. For a gallery wall, trace each frame on paper, tape the templates up first to test the layout, then mount the frames once the arrangement looks balanced and evenly spaced.
